OPERATIONAL SPECIFICATIONS

Site Survey Services & Technical Scope

Standardized field verification protocols designed for zero-touch CAD drafting, PE structural stamps, and rapid AHJ permit approval. Every survey includes our certified 36-photo standard.

DISCIPLINE 01

Roof & Structural Survey

Physical geometry verification that calibrates satellite models with millimeter accuracy.

While aerial imagery tools provide preliminary layouts, physical on-site verification confirms actual pitch, structural deflection, layer thickness, and obstruction coordinates required for solar module attachment engineering.

FIELD VERIFICATION CHECKPOINTS:

  • Roof Dimensions & Angles: Eave-to-ridge, rake-to-rake, valleys, and hips measured and cross-referenced with digital pitch gauges.
  • Roof Material & Layers: Asphalt shingle (3-tab vs architectural), clay/concrete tile (S-tile, flat tile), standing seam metal, or flat membrane (TPO/EPDM). Layer count verified.
  • Roof Condition Assessment: Granular loss, tile cracking, soft spots, ponding evidence, and estimated remaining lifespan (<5 years flagged).
  • Obstruction Mapping: Exact X/Y offsets from nearest ridge and eave for plumbing vents, attic turbines, skylights, chimneys, and satellite dishes.
  • Shading & Clearances: Tree overhangs, horizon obstructions, and IFC fire code setbacks (36" ridge / 36" valley).
PHOTO CODE: RF-01-AZIMUTH • DIGITAL PITCH GAUGE VERIFIED
DISCIPLINE 02

Electrical Service & Interconnection Survey

Eliminating 45% of change orders through rigorous main service panel (MSP) interior audits.

Our surveyors remove panel dead-fronts (where safe) to document internal busbar ratings, main breaker ampacity, spare breaker slots, and conduit pathways—providing electrical drafters with the exact data needed for NEC 705.12 calculations.

ELECTRICAL AUDIT PARAMETERS:

  • Main Service Panel (MSP): Manufacturer nameplate, model/catalog number, enclosure NEMA rating, and interior dead-front photograph.
  • Busbar & Main Breaker: Busbar amp rating (e.g. 125A, 200A, 225A) and main breaker ampacity for 120% rule compliance.
  • Interconnection Location: Assessment of opposite-end backfeed breaker slot availability, supply-side tap viability, or feeder tap box necessity.
  • Utility Meter & Socket: Meter number, digital display, meter socket rating, lever bypass presence, and clearance from gas meters (>36").
  • Grounding & Subpanels: Grounding electrode conductor (GEC) path to ground rod or water pipe, plus existing subpanel loads.
PHOTO CODE: EL-04-DEADFRONT • 120% RULE DATA CAPTURE
DISCIPLINE 03

Battery & Energy Storage (ESS) Clearances

Ensuring NFPA 855 compliance and seamless microgrid gateway integration.

With solar-plus-storage surging, site surveys must account for strict separation distances from windows and doors, structural wall anchor capacity, and continuous conduit routing between the battery bank, system controller, and main panel.

STORAGE SURVEY CHECKPOINTS:

  • NFPA 855 Spatial Boundaries: 3-foot minimum clearance verified from all operable windows, doors, and ventilation air intakes.
  • System Controller / Gateway Location: Proposed mounting wall with floor-to-ceiling elevation measurements and working space clearances (NEC 110.26).
  • Conduit Pathway & Run Length: Measured linear path and elevation changes between battery location and main service equipment.
  • Wall Structure & Anchoring: Stud framing inspection (16" vs 24" O.C.), concrete foundation wall, or masonry support check.
  • Critical Loads Subpanel: Inventory and photo directory of branch circuits targeted for backup islanding.
PHOTO CODE: ESS-02-CLEARANCE • NFPA 855 BOUNDARY CHECK
DISCIPLINE 04

Commercial (C&I) & Drone Aerial Surveys

High-resolution aerial photogrammetry and 3-phase industrial electrical audits.

For commercial rooftops, carports, and complex residential estates, our FAA Part 107 certified remote pilots capture 4K photogrammetric point clouds and orthomosaic maps, while commercial electricians audit 208V/480V switchgear.

COMMERCIAL AUDIT CAPABILITIES:

  • FAA Part 107 Drone Surveys: High-resolution 4K RGB orthomosaic maps, 3D point clouds, and thermal anomaly scans.
  • 3-Phase Electrical Switchboards: 120/208V and 277/480V main switchboard bus ratings, CT cabinets, and transformer nameplates.
  • Flat Commercial Roofs: TPO, EPDM, Built-Up, and standing seam roof deck assessments for ballasted or penetrating racking.
  • Structural Trusses & Decking: Open-web steel joist (OWSJ) and timber glulam truss measurements for PE structural calculations.
PHOTO CODE: DR-01-AERIAL • FAA PART 107 PHOTOGRAMMETRY
OPERATIONAL OUTPUT

The CAD-Ready Survey Deliverable Package

What your engineering and drafting team receives upon deliverable release.

01

36+ Geotagged 4K Photos

Organized into standardized folders (Property, Roof, Electrical, Structural, ESS) with high-resolution macro labels.

02

One-Touch CAD Dimension Sheet

Full roof geometry, plane azimuths, verified pitch angles, and obstruction offsets ready for AutoCAD or HelioScope import.

03

Single-Line Electrical Parameter Sheet

Bus rating, main breaker, wire sizes, grounding, and NEC 705.12 120% rule calculations documented by a certified auditor.

04

Structural Framing Report

Rafter dimensions, span lengths, on-center spacing, and decking condition for structural PE calculation stamps.

05

Battery & Gateway Clearance Report

NFPA 855 setback diagrams, stud wall anchor checks, and measured conduit run paths with elevation notes.

06

Triple-Check QA Verification Signoff

Pre-screened by our internal engineering desk to guarantee zero missing photos or ambiguous data points.
